source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 台风登陆半小时前后判若两地
topics.official_english: Typhoon Landfall: Two Radically Different Scenes Half an Hour Apart
topics.why_hot: A single typhoon landfall produced two dramatically different scenes in just 30 minutes, making it one of the most visually striking weather moments of the day.
topics.share_angle: Use side-by-side imagery to explain how typhoon conditions can change rapidly during landfall and how communities prepare for extreme weather.

topics.chinese_topic: “上海女子在台风中坠楼”不实
topics.official_english: Claim That Woman Fell From Building During Shanghai Typhoon Is False
topics.why_hot: A dramatic rumor spread quickly during the typhoon and was later denied, highlighting how fast misinformation can travel in a disaster.
topics.share_angle: Show how to verify fast-moving news during emergencies and why false claims become harder to correct once they go viral.

topics.official_english: Unitree Robotics Begins Share Subscription Today
topics.why_hot: The robotics company's IPO subscription opened to strong investor attention, especially as robots and AI become a major focus in China's tech sector.
topics.share_angle: Explain what Unitree's listing means for China's robotics and AI ambitions, and how retail investors are reacting to the subscription.

topics.chinese_topic: 手机真会“偷听”我们说话吗
topics.why_hot: Many users feel smartphones listen to them after seeing ads that match private conversations, sparking intense debate over digital privacy.
topics.share_angle: Break down how mobile apps collect data and explain the gap between 'eavesdropping' fears and actual ad-targeting algorithms.

topics.chinese_topic: 存款市场罕见两极分化
topics.why_hot: An unusual split in deposit trends caught the public's attention, raising questions about how people are saving and how banks compete for deposits.
topics.share_angle: Use this topic to explain changes in household saving behavior and what deposit-market polarization means for ordinary account holders.

topics.chinese_topic: 多地高分生扎堆填报中本贯通
topics.official_english: High-Scoring Students Flock to 'Secondary-to-Undergraduate' Programs in Multiple Regions
topics.why_hot: Students with strong exam scores are increasingly choosing the 'secondary-to-undergraduate' track, challenging old stereotypes about vocational education.
topics.share_angle: Explain how this pathway works, why families are embracing it, and what it says about education and employment priorities in China.

topics.official_english: White Dolphin Sightings Point to North China as Next Stop
topics.why_hot: A white dolphin story tied to North China sparked public curiosity about unusual marine animal appearances and what they signal for the environment.
topics.share_angle: Use this to explore marine conservation, shifting habitats, and how sightings of rare wildlife become public events.

topics.chinese_topic: 这些中国风热词上新了
topics.official_english: New 'Chinese Style' Buzzwords Enter the Lexicon
topics.why_hot: A fresh batch of 'Chinese style' buzzwords went viral, offering a fun window into how contemporary Chinese culture blends tradition and internet trends.
topics.share_angle: Pick several popular buzzwords, explain their meanings and origins, and show what they reveal about Chinese youth culture and identity.
